deviations.description: Discovered during Phase 2/3 verification: Group 30's pre-existing Cases D-F live fixture co-scheduled two build-heavy implement candidates (3004 lean4 + 3005 cslib) in one cycle -- exactly the combination Mode 2 now forbids. The new rule correctly deferred 3005 for the NEW reason before it ever reached the lock-probe/provision step Case E was designed to exercise, breaking that assertion. Split Group 30's live fixture into two cycles (3004+3006, then 3005 alone) to decouple isolation-selection/provision-failure testing (Group 30's own concern) from cross-task co-scheduling (Group 32's concern). Every original Group 30 assertion is preserved unchanged, just regrouped.
deviations.reason: This is a genuine, correctly-attributed interaction between the new rule and an old fixture's shape, not an implementation defect -- reported here per Phase 2's own verification guidance ('a real finding to report, not a fixture to silence') rather than silently patched.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- Group 30 Cases D-F split into two live cycles to decouple from Mode 2)*
